decisions.title: Rail Yards Blacksmith Shop Feasibility Study
decisions.description: Evaluates adaptive reuse of the historic Rail Yards Blacksmith Shop, documenting building history and condition, code requirements, rehabilitation constraints, programming, public-event concepts, accessibility, preservation standards, cost considerations, and conceptual drawings.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 61-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; the cover, contents, findings, historic-resource discussion, recommendations, and concept drawings were visually reviewed.
Retained as a rare detailed record connecting preservation analysis with proposed public reuse of the Rail Yards.

decisions.title: Yale Maintenance Facility Assessment — Draft Final Report, Volume 1
decisions.description: Assesses ABQ RIDE's Yale maintenance complex, documenting facility condition, bus circulation, maintenance and fueling operations, historic resources, space needs, design criteria, phased concepts, fleet projections, sustainability, and probable construction costs.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 265-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete extracted text and representative facility, design, and cost pages were reviewed.
The PDF was re-exported in 2022, but the document itself is dated June 2015.

decisions.title: Yale Maintenance Facility Assessment — Draft Final Report, Volume 2: Appendices
decisions.description: Preserves technical appendices supporting the Yale facility assessment, including planning maps, environmental and geotechnical records, hazardous-material surveys, building evaluations, fleet data, workshop material, cost estimates, and concept drawings.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 167-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete extracted text and representative maps, reports, tables, and drawings were reviewed.
The 25668004-byte file is below the project's 25 MiB reporting threshold and the 100 MB approval threshold.

decisions.title: 98th Street and Benavides Road Intersection Assessment — Part 1
decisions.description: Evaluates 98th Street and Benavides Road geometry, access, sight distance, multimodal facilities, lighting, utilities, pavement, traffic operations, signal warrants, queues, crashes, and recommended intersection configurations and pedestrian improvements.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 42-page PDF preserved without modification.

decisions.title: 98th Street and Benavides Road Intersection Assessment — Part 2: Appendices
decisions.description: Provides the assessment's supporting planning maps, field photographs, traffic counts, signal-warrant worksheets, Synchro operations results, crash records, utility documentation, turning templates, and concept alternatives.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 47-page PDF preserved without modification.

decisions.title: Explora STEAM Campus Master Plan — Draft

decisions.title: Neighborhood Traffic Management Program Study Group Draft
decisions.description: Records the City study group's review of neighborhood traffic-calming policy, installed devices, emergency routes, effectiveness, funding, public participation, education, application procedures, and recommendations that informed later STEP and NTMP manuals.

decisions.title: Volcano Mesa Plans — Proposed Transportation Text Amendments
decisions.description: Explains proposed 2014 transportation amendments across the Volcano Cliffs, Volcano Heights, Volcano Trails, and West Side plans, comparing roadway-network maps, Paseo del Norte and Unser cross-sections, frontage roads, and multimodal design.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 18-page presentation preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; all presentation pages, network maps, cross-sections, comparisons, and amendment summary were reviewed.

decisions.title: Rail Yards Blacksmith Shop Environmental Sampling Report
decisions.description: Documents 2012 Blacksmith Shop air and settled-dust testing for lead and volatile organic compounds, laboratory results, identified hazards, cleanup recommendations, worker-occupancy concerns, and implications for adaptive reuse.
decisions.provenance_status: official City metadata page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative seven-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; the complete report, conclusions, recommendations, and laboratory attachments were reviewed.
Retained as a companion environmental record to the Blacksmith Shop feasibility study.

decisions.title: Antibiotic Resistance Analysis of Contamination in Stormwater — Final Report
decisions.description: Investigates fecal-contamination sources in Albuquerque stormwater using antibiotic-resistance analysis, sampling arroyos, channels, dams, and pump stations; it documents methods, source libraries, results, site maps, photographs, and recommended technology transfer.
decisions.provenance_status: official City source page and byte-identical City-hosted file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 26-page final report preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; the complete text, cover, site maps, photographs, results, and recommendations were reviewed.
